checks.name: actual billing endpoint requires owner session and same-site origin; legacy key GET cannot create self-service checkout
review and real-handler Checkout preserve accepted99monthly price, tenant, terms and one idempotent session across parallel clicks
unapproved offers, unsupported Enterprise, missing agreement, stale revision and changed Stripe currency/price/account stop checkout
requests for unfinished connections or caps inconsistent with enforced policies cannot start paid service
lost Checkout response retries the same parameters/key inside retention and reconciles instead of charging again
signed completion records actual active subscription; duplicate and older event snapshots cannot regress canonical state
invoice failure follows exact customer/subscription binding and authoritative current subscription, without trusting invoice snapshot
tenant reincarnation and foreign customer/subscription cannot inherit old subscription or grant paid status
renewal cancellation survives lost response and ordinary scheduler confirms the same subscription with no duplicate mutation
signature failures, stale signed deliveries and legacy slug metadata cannot mutate a self-service customer
revoking the owner while account read is pending prevents the actual Checkout POST
unknown Checkout older than retention is held and searched, never retried with a reusable expired key
month-end cancellation and incomplete-expired failure allow a new explicitly reviewed checkout without changing customer identity
a lost cancellation still unapplied after retention safely renews only its idempotent end-renewal mutation
ordinary stop-service expires the same unpaid hosted Checkout; late events cannot reopen it
a payment that completed while stop was being processed is retained and its next renewal ends automatically
an early signed completion cannot be downgraded by a delayed open-session POST response
restricted live credentials require separate activation and invalid commercial offers make no Stripe request
a Price changed after review abandons its unsent request safely and allows a fresh accepted checkout
authoritative line-item quantity mismatch and wrong test/live event cannot record paid status
existing confirmed customer opens only its scoped payment-details and invoice portal even when new purchases are disabled
portal refuses shared default, inactive, live, foreign app, wrong metadata, login and expanded feature configurations before dispatch
portal rejects foreign owners, custom body redirects, unconfirmed payment, replaced tenants and mismatched canonical customer/subscription
revoked owner during portal validation cannot dispatch a hosted session
lost portal response retries only the same capability request; expired retry needs a fresh explicit owner action
portal rejects unexpected hosted response host, account mode, customer, configuration and return URL
all-service offer charges only the requested ready service scope and a changed selection invalidates review
verified Calendar-only customer in operating testing lifecycle can purchase without website installation; billing never activates channels

never: Quote a price the owner has not published
Promise an exact arrival time; offer the arrival windows only
Give advice on gas, electrical, or safety beyond: leave the area if there is a gas smell or fire, call 911, then call us
handoff: Anything about a bill or refund

tier0: Sparks or a burning smell from the panel or an outlet
tier1: No cooling when the forecast high is 90°F or more
No cooling with an infant, elderly, or medically dependent person in the home
No heat when it is at or below freezing outside
Water pouring from the air handler
emergencies.tier2: Everything else: offer the next available window.
